content.text: {"issues":[{"description":"Listeners object to restrictions on choosing, skipping, and replaying specific songs, especially when these controls are limited to encourage a Premium subscription.","issue_id":"ISSUE-USABILITY","name":"Song selection and playback controls"},{"description":"Reviews give a broad negative judgment of the app or its update without identifying a specific problem.","issue_id":"ISSUE-OTHER","name":"General dissatisfaction"},{"description":"The app crashes, fails to load, or does not start playback as expected, including through Google Assistant.","issue_id":"ISSUE-PLAYBACK","name":"App startup and playback failures"},{"description":"Listeners report missing songs or limited availability of particular genres, as well as inconsistent lyrics coverage.","issue_id":"ISSUE-CATALOG","name":"Missing music and content"},{"description":"Users complain that basic listening controls are restricted to Premium subscribers, describing the changes as an unwanted push to pay.","issue_id":"ISSUE-BILLING","name":"Paid-plan restrictions"},{"description":"Users cannot access their accounts, including problems signing in or having a password accepted.","issue_id":"ISSUE-ACCESS","name":"Account access and sign-in"},{"description":"Downloads get stuck or offline listening does not work reliably.","issue_id":"ISSUE-DOWNLOADS","name":"Downloads and offline listening"},{"description":"A review expresses dissatisfaction with Spotify’s support stance without describing a specific support interaction.","issue_id":"ISSUE-SUPPORT","name":"Support-related dissatisfaction"}]}
